name: Bonneville

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: Ah... what do you mean someone's up at this hour... me? I've barely slept a wink... I really do have to give it to you folks who are up and about at every hour... you'll be able to find me in my dorm in bed before midday anyway... if there's an emergency, wake me up whenever. Of course, there'd better be... a real emergency.

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: Yaaaaawn... good morning, Professor... gah, good afternoon, sorry. Such light tea... this what you use as a pick-me-up? Not what I would have gone for. Speaking of which, ever given root beer a go?

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: My time to shine! Wanna go for a round or two with me? The engine's roar and blowing breeze'll perk you right up. Here, I've even set aside a helmet for you. Won't you indulge me, Professor?

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: Man, I'm back, and you're still working? Come on, there have to be limits to everything; why can't you rest up and tackle it tomorrow? It's something pressing, then... you asking why I'm getting off my bike? To keep you company, of course. I'll give you a ride back to the dorms when you're done. I can't just leave you here in the dead of night, can I?

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: I do like a drive at night. A wide and open road, and silence all the way down. The twisting street lights flow by like a river, passing in the rearview mirror. Your mind empties itself as you speed along. That's when you're truly free.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: You want to try the motorcycle as well, Professor? Well... give the baby a twist, and the timid little kitten underneath you'll turn right into a fierce tiger! Only the finest of riders can harness this fury. As for you, Professor... hehe, I wouldn't if I were you. Just hang on behind me and sit still.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: The Professor? Asleep? Always so stern and solemn, but ain't this a cute side of ya... Don't mind if I look a bit longer at this version of you no one else gets to see.

voices.label: Home Screen 4
voices.text: Nascita was talking about a stunt where she leaps off a moving vehicle, and delivers a moving kick to a target... ah, no, don't get the wrong idea. I wouldn't think about trying that, never!

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: The road's a little bumpy. Hang onto me if you don't want to get thrown off. Hehe, your face is so hot... you embarrassed?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: Hey, I'm ticklish! Don't do that when we're out on a ride!

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: Curious about this here, are we? Want to take a closer look?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: Hehehe, are you trying to tease me, Professor?

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: I'm here. Rest easy.

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: Motorcyclist Bonneville, reporting in! You're Professor <cmdr>? You look easy to get along with! Why don't you hop on? I'll take you round for a good time!

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: Even more horsepower!

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: New transmission? Sick!

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: The best money can buy! This should give me the speed I'm looking for!

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: Faster! Give it everything you have!

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: Here we go!

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: Full horsepower!

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: First place again?

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: That's it? I'm not satisfied yet!

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: I can't stop... just yet...

voices.label: Oath
voices.text: Swearing an oath with me? Hehe, you're the only thing that's given me this many surprises other than the road. Well, this bike's got a new owner from now on. No matter how fast I go, I'll always have this connection, helping me keep my balance.

voices.label: New Year
voices.text: Happy New Year, Professor. Come, grab your helmet, let's get off to a fast start this year! All the Oasis' colors in sight, all the liveliness in the air... makes me excited just thinking about a drive, with you next to me.

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text: Happy Valentine's, Professor! These chocolates are for you. I'll have you know I rarely get busy in the kitchen myself, so you'd better take this and cherish it. I made a big batch, and gave most of it to friends, but... your portion's special, Professor. As for how exactly... you'll find out when you taste it.

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text: My Tanabata special, the midnight star-seeing express~ I've saved a first-class seat for you, Professor. Wanna come along? I hear that today we'll get to see two brilliant stars align. When we're there, we can have a barbecue—get the best of both worlds.

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text: Ta-dahh! It's Pumpkin Rider! You've seen that film too, Professor? Hahahaha, it's damn hard to get your hands on a burning skull, so a pumpkin helmet'll have to do! Get on, Professor! Let's go and give those cheeky little bastards a good scare... oh, come on, are you really going to ask me for candy as well?!

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text: Merry Christmas, Professor. I prepared a present long ago. Seeing as it's a special occasion, I suppose I'll spend a nice and cozy day with you by the fireplace. You want to go out and deliver presents? I'll come with, then. My bike's way faster than Santa's dinky reindeer.

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text: Happy Birthday, Professor. Come, I've prepared a most special journey for you. I've got a lot of sights left to see with you. Know that there's always a spot for you on the back seat of this bike, so long as you're willing.

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text: Ah, crap... bike's gone AWOL again. Good timing, Professor. I don't know who's nicked my bike. Even the Oasis has car thieves? Erika's been here? Her again... my baby's got a special spot for red hair. Moment it sees red, it thinks that's its owner. All you need to steal the thing is a wig... I gotta put up a sign next time I park! No redheads allowed in this area!

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text: Daily patrol's not as dull as I imagined. Speeding along the boundless horizon of the Null Zone, with the wind blowing past me and no speed limit in sight. So long as I have that, I'll never be lonely, with nothing but boundless joy in my heart. Of course, I would be more than willing to share that joy with a certain someone. I think the Professor would be my first choice for a riding partner. With all of that from me, shouldn't you respond in kind just a little?

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text: High-calorie foods like burgers suit me more than sweets. Fried foods and carbs aren't as exquisite as sweets visually, but I wouldn't have anything else for replenishing energy. Which of these do you like, Professor? Both of them... haha, clever answer. Not wrong though, food's a damn blessing from above. Being able to eat at all in this bleak world is already nothing short of a luxury.

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text: Hm? Where's this photo from? That Doll is indeed me... you watch motorcycle racing, too? I've partaken in a few myself. This should be the Global Motorcycle Championship finals' 9th bend, no? Of course, I won. Though... after that, I wasn't a professional racing Doll anymore.

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text: Ever since I came out of the factory, I've pursued speed. "Faster" is written into my base commands, and braking is almost a foreign concept to me... It was you, Professor, who taught me that the Oasis isn't the race grounds. I can afford to take it a bit slower here. So don't you worry about me, I'm just enjoying myself right now. Not for the sake of glory or accolades, or the sound of empty cheers. It's nice to get some wind in your face occasionally, no?

voices.label: Agreement
voices.text: Mhmm—

career:
The MCR model, developed by Cyber Media, fills a niche in the market by providing affordable Doll drivers for various motorsport competitions, both professional and amateur. Given the complex and dangerous nature of motorsports, particularly motorcycling, the model's internal structure allows for extensive customization by third parties to meet the specific demands of different levels and types of racing. This flexibility has made the model popular among small to medium-sized racing teams and civilian motorcycle clubs.

Bonneville, a former professional motorcyclist, was once a frequent presence at the top of the podium. Her driving style, though wild and daring, was a spectacle to behold. She often performed high-risk maneuvers with the aim of breaking records, earning her a dedicated fan base. However, following a particular tournament, Bonneville was forced to retire and subsequently joined Project Neural Cloud.
infoStories:
Globally recognized as a popular sport, racing is also known for its inherent dangers, which surpass those of other sports. Despite significant advancements in vehicle safety, the risk of severe injury remains high, particularly in motorcycle racing, where casualties occur nearly annually. The time and resources required to train a professional driver are substantial, leading to the exploration of "AI-powered robots as partial replacements for human drivers" as early as 2030.

Cyber Media's MCR model embodies the culmination of this concept. Technological advancements have enabled the MCR to execute complex maneuvers and techniques previously deemed impractical, quickly gaining favor with its target audience. Since 2054, numerous motorsports hosts have organized events specifically for Dolls, and the MCR has excelled in these competitions.

Another unspoken reason for the popularity of racing Dolls lies in their ability to push the limits of the sport without fear, resulting in more thrilling races and enthusiastic bettors.

The name "Bonneville" is a tribute to the Bonneville Salt Flats in Utah, a mecca for land speed records and a common destination for race cars and modified vehicles. It also reflects the former team owner's passion for cars and motorcycles, particularly a cherished vintage bike named "Bonneville".

As a professional Doll, Bonneville possessed inherent driving expertise upon joining the team, but still underwent the prescribed training regimen. While the training period was expedited, it nonetheless spanned nearly six months.

From the fundamentals of a 125cc A1 motorcycle to a stripped-down race car lacking amenities like ABS, human drivers must complete numerous drills of varying complexity. Bonneville diligently underwent this comprehensive training. Subsequently, technicians fine-tuned Bonneville's body based on the collected data, optimizing her performance. In a comparative test, a fully trained Bonneville outperformed other untrained MCR models by an entire weight class.

Bonneville's on-track style is best described as aggressive and fiery. A media outlet once remarked: "When she's behind the wheel, she almost seems to embody a ghostly rider, flaming aura and all."

As racing Dolls became more prevalent, regulations began to loosen, allowing her to showcase her more passionate side. Instead of major international events like the N-WSBK burdened with numerous rules, she favored local club competitions with relaxed regulations, enabling her to unleash her full potential and defeat opponents in the most audacious manner. She even adorned her vehicle with armaments for "self-defense", though it was purely for aesthetic purposes, as they were non-functional on the track.

Within six months of becoming certified, Bonneville was already a prominent figure in local clubs, earning the reputation of both a champion and the infamous "Road Rage King." Her aggressive driving style resulted in at least 20 minor and 3 major reprimands within six months, along with a temporary ban from competing. Roughly six months later, her team arranged for her to participate in the N-WSBK championship, but a neural limiter was installed to curb her brash behavior in the big leagues.

This modification had an unintended consequence: Bonneville's initial performance in the N-WSBK was lackluster.

With the neural limiter removed, Bonneville adapted her driving style, focusing on improving in-the-moment precision in large-scale races and reducing rule violations in preparation for the next N-WSBK season. Her efforts paid off, earning her first place in three stages and a third-place finish in the finals. Subsequently, Bonneville dominated the N-WSBK championship, winning four consecutive titles.

However, her success attracted controversy. A renowned veteran team, IA, filed a complaint accusing Bonneville of using illicit methods to gain an advantage. This sparked a heated dispute, escalating into a physical altercation. To ensure fair competition, the referee committee intervened, and imposed a three-month ban on Bonneville. A subsequent investigation revealed the accusations were unfounded, but the conflict between the two teams remained irreparable. In June of that year, Bonneville announced her departure from the team and withdrawal from the N-WSBK championship.

Returning to the local scene without a sponsor, Bonneville reverted to her former driving style. Now solely responsible for the costs of competing and vehicle maintenance, she ventured into the world of open-road motorcycle racing. This unregulated, high-risk, high-reward environment featured unpredictable competitors, including the occasional rogue patrol officer and aggressive motorcycle gangs.

The dilapidated garages of the slums, coffee shops tucked away in alley corners, club rooms filled with the scent of machine oil, and worn-down public roads in the dead of night—reminiscing about those days invariably brings a bittersweet smile to Bonneville's face. In her words, it was a harsh, dangerous, and unglamorous existence but one that offered unparalleled freedom. While she lost certain things, she gained something she desired in return. "Just like the main characters of those old-ass gangster movies".

One day, Bonneville abruptly left her residence, selling her garage and all its contents except for her personal motorcycle. She vanished without a trace. Apart from a few devoted motorcycle fans who occasionally mentioned her name, it was as if she never existed, much like countless other Civilian Dolls.

After joining the Guardians, Bonneville retained her independent spirit. Leveraging the speed and agility of her motorcycle, she effortlessly navigates Magrasea instead of remaining at Arcadia's headquarters. Even in the rare event of encountering a Sanctifier, she can easily evade them.

Bonneville's preferred destination is undoubtedly Burbank—this perpetually illuminated city is sure to have a few ruffians roaming the streets at midnight. She relishes the opportunity to give those rowdy troublemakers a good thrashing.
oathDesc: Traversing everything, surpassing everything, facing everything. Together.

""Hehehe, the sweet sweet smell of hot melted tires on asphalt, burning to the heart's desire... let me teach you how to enjoy these things!""

Attire and environment produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea, which mirrors their life in the real world.
""Get out of the way, goddamn slug! Or—you're about to fly into the air like a champagne cork!""

skinList.name: Carmine Cavalier
skinList.desc:
The ""Carmine Knight"", head of the Royal Knight Squadron, at the end of a day's patrols, cordially invites you to some private time in candlelight.
""The time calls for something from my personal cellars. This is, as the legends would have it, a most fine vintage created using a method left behind by a pirate. As for whether or not this'll get in the way of tomorrow's work... that's not a matter we need to be concerned with right now.""
